title: RATIB ERP ENTERPRISE PERFORMANCE ROOT CAUSE AUDIT
score_basis: Average cold sidebar afterEnter across HR/Inventory/Accounting (cache cleared). Warm path excluded from score.

root_cause.primary: Cold first sidebar click waits 16–25s on X-Rateb-Nav-Swap fetch because idlePrefetchVisible concurrently downloads many full HTML documents (prefetchUrl), saturating browser networking. Isolated curl TTFB for same pages is 137–177ms.
root_cause.secondary_why_second_fast: Second click hits Cache API (fromCache:true); afterEnter 15–29ms; no critical-path swap network fetch.
root_cause.offline: With clean Cache API hit, offline afterEnter 51.9ms / usable 70.2ms. Slow offline perception correlates with cache miss, large DOM (finance 1.9s), or overlapping failed/hung prefetch (contaminated 833ms run), not absence of cache infrastructure.

why.evidence: if (!self:: || headers_sent()) { return; } — layout main.php echoes HTML before shutdown, so headers already sent

part4_prefetch.verdict: Useful only if they finish BEFORE click and populate Cache API. During cold click they are harmful (compete with swap). Hover waterfall empty in prior idle window sample; idle IntersectionObserver dominates.
